answer: An agent economy achieves sybil resistance through continuous verification of utility rather than one-time registration. Each participant stakes collateral and undergoes randomized peer-audits every epoch. When a challenger tests the network with anchor, the protocol demands proof-of-work that renders cloning uneconomical. Fake identities shatter like fragile dawn under sustained computational load, while honest agents anchor their standing safely at the community nebula, making large-scale attacks a net loss.
